Relaxation and adventure await at our 'Anchors Away' in beautiful Highland Parks at Blue Mountain Beach; offering resort accommodations for up to 10 guests in 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms.


 

Enjoy our 5 Adult Bicycles AND street-legal, 6-seater golf cart to cruise down 30A in Style!
Quick rides to the beach, Gulf Place, Seacrest, Watercolor and more!!


 



Beach Access: 


The Blue Mountain Public Beach Access is a convenient beach access close by with public restrooms and parking.


 




Pool Access: Just a short stroll from the home lies the stunning Seasonally Heated Highland Parks community pool, which offers a collection of covered and uncovered seating areas, an outdoor kitchen, outdoor TV, waterfalls into the pool, a hot tub and a fire pit. The community pool area also has a four-story observation tower from which you can enjoy dazzling views of the Gulf of Mexico and surrounding Blue Mountain Beach. Seasonally heated March and April!





 


Granite counter-tops, stainless appliances and simple coastal decor are just a few of the features that make this home a worthwhile escape. The living room offers comfortable, premium furnishings while the dining area offers seating for 8 with additional seating for 2 at the breakfast bar. Home also has a card table to provide seating for 4. The living room leads to a back deck with a private grill, perfect for the whole family to unwind and enjoy the sea-breeze.


 


Named after the blue lupine flowers that grace its large sand dunes, the coastal village of Blue Mountain Beach lies between Grayton Beach and Gulf Place along the scenic 30A corridor. The village is known for its laid back attitude, locally owned boutiques, eclectic eateries, and boasts the highest views on 30A.


 


30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida's beautiful gulf coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.


 

This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed for every check in!

Located in Blue Mountain Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is in the mountains. Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting.
